current_suggestion.pitch: Vacanti is a serious, data-literate fitness coach who steelmans the evidence-based side of nutrition and hypertrophy without the celebrity polish of Renaissance Periodization or the carnivore framing of Saladino/Chaffee — he occupies the rigorous middle and will push back on claims your current channels make. His content covers programming, protein, and body composition with practitioner-level specificity drawn from years of coaching real clients, not just interpreting studies. Format is mostly solo or co-hosted with Jordan Syatt — conversational but substantive, no fluff.
